audit_two_passes.method: The same model replays the 4 recorded base-code v7 policy games twice through reconstruct_behavior (audit_passes.py), 3 interleaved repeats. The second pass finds what the first left in the model's inference memos, as training's admission audit finds what collection left when it audits with the collecting model.

audit_two_passes_v8.method: The same model replays the 4 recorded base-code v8 policy games twice through reconstruct_behavior (audit_passes.py), 3 interleaved repeats. The second pass finds what the first left in the model's inference memos, as training's admission audit finds what collection left when it audits with the collecting model.

capture_verification.note: Each process builds every observation it would skip, fails the game on any disagreement and reports confirmed skips on stderr at powers of ten. The host process is the embedded engine (none for the cold backend, whose game processes log separately); other processes are cold game processes and vcmireplay. The stalled poison game stops early by design. Every run passed.

code.note: base is the embedded engine branch head; its code equals d74e1f5, the parent of the first acceleration commit.

controller_replay.method: Engine-free replay of the 4 recorded base-code v7 policy games (603 decisions, 4023 frames) through BuiltinCollector.act and finish, requiring every choice (with its log-probability and conditionals), value, estimate, recurrent prefix and the history to equal the persisted base rollout. Base receives wire records; accelerated also receives the typed frames, as its environments do. 3 interleaved repeats, torch.set_num_threads(1).

controller_replay_two_passes.method: The same model replays the 4 recorded base-code v7 policy games twice through the collector (controller_replay.py --repeat 2, accelerated with --typed), 3 interleaved repeats. The second pass finds what the first left in the model's inference memos, as training's admission audit finds what collection left when it audits with the collecting model.

controller_replay_v8.method: Engine-free replay of the 4 recorded base-code v8 policy games (342 decisions, 2317 frames) through BuiltinCollector.act and finish, requiring every choice (with its log-probability and conditionals), value, estimate, recurrent prefix and the history to equal the persisted base rollout. Base receives wire records; accelerated also receives the typed frames, as its environments do. 3 interleaved repeats, torch.set_num_threads(1).

embedded_ab_host_a.note: The same embedded A/B on the final code, run before the restart.

findings.finding: WeightsSnapshot.matches raised RuntimeError for a one-tensor state_dict whose storage starts inside an 8-byte word
findings.fix: copy such a view before reading it as int64 words

findings.finding: the observation memo's 64 MiB bound counted only the cells tensor of each entry
findings.fix: charge the key, the entry, every tree object and every tensor once
findings.skeptics_refuting: 2 of 2 (outputs unchanged and memory bounded, but the facts confirmed)

findings.finding: environment frames replaced their records after a text comparison that does not reject tuples or subclasses the strict decoder rejects
findings.fix: use the frames only when every record also has exact JSON types; otherwise take the original strict-decoding path

findings.finding: no automated test covers the native unchanged-view capture skip
findings.fix: narrowed, not closed: a source-level test pins HEROES_VERIFY_NATIVE_CAPTURE as the native code's only environment switch, checks that it builds every skipped capture and fails on disagreement, and checks that it survives every launcher's environment filter; the final revalidation ran with the switch on
findings.test: fails on the first version of the switch (before 89f377e), passes on the reviewed code; it reads source text and does not run the skip

findings.finding: one differential test class sat after the unittest main guard and did not run when the file was executed as a script
findings.fix: move the main guard to the end of the file
findings.test: none (the class runs under unittest discovery either way)

independent_review.note: Reviewers and skeptics were independent model agents; their transcripts are not kept in the repository.
independent_review.reviewed: diff b70442d..a904c53 (the acceleration code at 89f377e plus the merged validation records)
independent_review.verification: two independent skeptics per finding, each asked to refute it

method: Interleaved A/B: each round runs every workload once per configuration, base then accelerated, sequentially on an otherwise idle machine. 4 episodes per run (seats 0,1,0,1), 1024 choices, 365 days, natural endings; every row replayed by vcmireplay and every policy row audited. Round 1 is warm-up and excluded from medians.

platform.host_a: x86-64 cloud VM, Intel Xeon @ 2.10GHz, 4 vCPUs, 15 GiB
platform.host_b: x86-64 cloud VM, Intel Xeon Processor @ 2.80GHz, 4 vCPUs, 15 GiB (same VM image after a container restart)
platform.note: The container was restarted onto different hardware during the final measurements. Every timing section and the capture verification name their host; base and accelerated are only compared within one host. The final revalidation, the base-code resubmissions and the capture verification ran on host A.

repeated_reset_soak.method: Embedded runs use one engine per run with one reused environment per seat (seats 0 and 1 alternating: 12 games each in the 24-game end-turn runs, 6 each in the 12-game policy runs); cold runs start a new game process per game. perf stat counts the whole probe process: 24 end-turn games per run in 3 interleaved rounds per configuration, then 8 cold end-turn games and 12 embedded v7 policy games per configuration; no replay or audit. rss_trajectory is read after each game; rss_after_load before the first.

review_fix_costs.method: review_fix_costs.py over the 4 recorded base-code v7 policy games: the observation memo's charged bytes against an independent deep measurement of what its entries keep (tensors as data plus 450 bytes), the memo charge timed over all stored entries, and the exact-JSON-type check timed over all delivered records.

scaling.method: K concurrent probe processes, each with its own embedded engine: v7 policy (seed 21), 4 games per worker with identical engine and policy seeds (121902/121903; seats red, blue, red, blue), full rows with vcmireplay and policy audit. Wall time includes process start, imports and engine load. One run per worker count and configuration.

scaling_host_a.method: K concurrent probe processes, each with its own embedded engine: v7 policy (seed 21), 4 games per worker with identical engine and policy seeds (121902/121903; seats red, blue, red, blue), full rows with vcmireplay and policy audit. Wall time includes process start, imports and engine load. One run per worker count and configuration.
scaling_host_a.note: An earlier run of the same scaling workload on host A, on code 89f377e (before the review fixes in bfb8590 and 6c120c9).

scope: Evaluation-only real VCMI games on Linux. No training, PPO, rewards, demonstrations or map changes. Policy rows use the labelled freshly initialized v7/v8 model (seed 21); recorded rows resubmit the delivered actions of an earlier policy run of the base code.
